notes.title: August 26th Item Update Notice
notes.notes:
Added a quick game restart button.

In response to feedback that player speed-up items were actually a hindrance, we've improved how they work.
Now instead of increasing player movement speed, they slow down time around you!

Some items have had their performances improved.

notes.title: New language support!
notes.notes:
At the time of release, only three languages were supported: Korean, English, and Japanese.
Three new languages have been added with this update!

The added languages are as follows!

-Chinese (Simplified)
-Traditional Chinese)
-Spanish

Thank you always for your interest and love.

notes.title: The game launches today!
notes.notes:
[b]13 Seconds will be released on March 8th at 1:30AM (PST)
Thank you for your support![/b]
